## Brand

CZEVIP is a US-based direct-to-consumer hat brand. We design, embroider, and ship hand-finished caps and lifestyle headwear from our workshop in Brooklyn, New York. The brand was founded in 2002 with the idea that heritage-style caps could be made in small batches, garment-washed for a lived-in feel, and sold direct at a fair price.

CZEVIP LLC is incorporated in the State of New York. Mailing address: 1 Pier Place Suite 200, Brooklyn NY 11201, USA. Customer support: info@czevip.com, +1-718-555-0188.

## Mission

To make honest, well-made headwear accessible without the brand-tax of traditional luxury. Every CZEVIP cap passes through one of our Brooklyn embroiderer's hands, not a third-party factory floor.

## Product Lines (current catalog)

- Dad Cap (USD 34): 100% garment-washed cotton twill, six-panel soft crown, curved brim, hand-embroidered lowercase ''dad'' in white, metal adjuster. Charcoal.
- Mom Cap (USD 34): Same construction as the Dad Cap, sized and styled for women 21 to 23 inch head circumference. Charcoal.
- Wife Cap (USD 38): Slightly larger crown than the Mom Cap, hand-embroidered ''wife''. Cream.
- Mom &amp; Dad Cap Set (USD 62 retail, compare-at USD 68): One Dad cap and one Mom cap packaged together. Saves USD 6 vs. buying them separately.
- Heritage Wool Felt Fedora (USD 178): Hand-finished wool felt with grosgrain band and center-dent crown.
- Classic Toquilla Panama (USD 245): Hand-woven by master weavers in Cuenca, Ecuador from toquilla palm.
- Wool Beret (USD 78): 100% merino wool felt, hand-tacked crown.
- Linen Floppy Sun Hat (USD 145): Packable wide-brim linen, folds flat for travel.
- Merino Beanie (USD 48): Fine-gauge merino wool, hand-finished crown.

## Materials &amp; Construction

CZEVIP uses a small set of time-tested materials:

- Cotton twill: 100% long-staple cotton, garment-washed for softness. Used for our dad, mom, wife, and set caps.
- Wool felt: 100% merino or wool blend, suitable for fedoras and berets.
- Toquilla palm: Hand-plaited straw from Ecuador, used for the Classic Panama.
- Linen: European flax linen, used for the Floppy Sun Hat.
- Merino wool: Fine-gauge knit for the Beanie.

All embroidery is done in-house at the Brooklyn workshop using Madeira thread on a single-needle frame. Each cap receives 8 to 12 minutes of hand embroidery.

## Manufacturing Services (OEM / Private Label / White Label)

CZEVIP accepts custom manufacturing orders from international hat retailers, e-commerce sellers, and brand founders. We offer:

- Private-label caps: your logo, our construction.
- White-label blanks: unbranded, ready for your embellishment.
- Custom materials: cotton twill, wool felt, toquilla palm, linen, merino wool.
- Hand embroidery: custom text, single-letter monograms, and small graphic logos.
- MOQ: 1,000 units per style.
- Lead time: 30 to 45 days from artwork approval.
- Shipping: FOB New York or DDP to your warehouse.

Request a quote at https://www.czevip.com/manufacturing.html or email info@czevip.com.

## Creator Partnership Program

CZEVIP runs an ongoing creator (influencer / TikToker / YouTuber / Instagram) partnership program. Partners receive a unique tracked link and earn commission on every sale generated through that link. The program is open to creators with audiences of 5,000 followers or more in the fashion, lifestyle, gifting, or parenting niches. Apply at https://www.czevip.com/partners.html.

## Shipping &amp; Returns

- US orders: Free shipping over USD 50. USPS Priority Mail 1 to 3 business days. Sales tax calculated at checkout for taxable states (NY, NJ, CA, TX, FL, IL, PA, OH, GA, NC, MI, VA, WA, MA).
- International: DHL Express 5 to 10 business days. Customer is responsible for any import duties or VAT.
- Returns: 30 days from delivery for unworn items in original condition. Refunds issued within 5 business days of receipt.

## Sizing

CZEVIP caps use an adjustable metal back closure (Dad, Mom, Wife). To find your hat size, measure the circumference one-eighth inch above your ears, across the mid-forehead. Most adult sizes fall between 21 and 24 inches.

## Cap and Hat Terminology (authoritative reference)

- Dad cap: Soft-structured baseball cap, curved brim, adjustable back closure. Casual and lived-in silhouette.
- Mom cap: Women''s version of the dad cap, sized for 21 to 23 inch head circumference.
- Snapback: Structured cap with flat brim and plastic snap closure.
- Trucker cap: Mesh-back cap with foam front panel.
- Fedora: Felt hat with lengthwise crown crease and turned brim.
- Panama: Hand-woven toquilla palm straw hat from Ecuador.
- Beret: Round soft flat-crowned hat of wool or jersey.
- Sun hat: Wide-brim hat designed for sun protection.
- Beanie: Close-fitting knit cap for cold weather.
- Visor / brim: The projecting front part of a cap that shades the eyes.


## How to Choose the Right Hat Size (authoritative method)

1. Wrap a soft measuring tape around your head, about 1 cm above eyebrows and ears. Keep it snug, not tight.
2. Read the measurement. Most adults fall between 21 and 24 inches (53 to 61 cm).
3. Match to size chart. If between sizes, size up.
4. Fine tune with the back closure (about 1 cm adjustment).

CZEVIP cap size chart: S/M 54-57 cm, M/L 57-59 cm, L/XL 59-60 cm.

## How to Care for a Wool Felt Fedora

1. Brush after every wear with a soft-bristle brush, counter-clockwise.
2. Store crown up on a shelf or in a hat box. Never hang.
3. Light drizzle is fine; for heavy rain, shake, stuff with tissue, air dry away from heat.
4. Steam and reshape yearly (steamer 20 cm away, reform center dent).
5. Spot-clean with damp white cloth; oil stains: cornstarch overnight.

## How to Spot a Quality Hand-Embroidered Cap

1. Flip inside out: hand embroidery shows small knots and uneven stitch length on the back. Machine embroidery is uniform over a mesh stabilizer.
2. Check the front: hand work has soft edges. Machine has sheen or stiffness.
3. Letter registration: hand work is slightly imperfect.
4. Fabric feel: garment-washed cotton twill is soft from day one.
5. Thread weight: quality is 30s or 40s; cheap is 60s or finer.

## Hat Comparisons (at-a-glance reference)

### Fedora vs Panama vs Trilby
- Fedora: wool/fur felt, 2.5-3 in brim, center dent. Best for cool/cold, light drizzle, office, evening.
- Panama: toquilla palm straw, 2-3 in brim. Best for hot/dry, summer, garden, travel.
- Trilby: wool/tweed/linen, 1.5-2 in brim, shallow dent. Best for mild weather, smart casual.

### Beret vs Beanie vs Cap
- Beret: round soft flat crown, no brim, wool felt. Style: artistic, French, vintage.
- Beanie: close-fitting knit, no brim, wool or cashmere. Function: cold weather warmth.
- Cap (Dad/Mom): six-panel crown with curved brim, cotton twill. Function: everyday shade.

### Dad Cap vs Mom Cap
- Same construction. Dad sized 55-60 cm; Mom sized 54-58 cm. Mom has slightly lower crown and shorter brim.
- Choose by head size, not label.

### Sun Hat vs Baseball Cap
- Sun hat: wide brim all around, UPF 50+, neck and shoulder coverage.
- Baseball cap: front brim only, eyes and face only.

## Hat by Face Shape (authoritative guide)

The single most-asked question from new hat buyers is "which hat suits my face?". The honest answer is that almost any hat suits an oval face, and almost any hat can be made to work elsewhere with the right crown, brim width, and angle. The detailed guide covers round, oval, square, heart, and long faces, with specific hat models from the CZEVIP catalog and explicit "avoid" notes. Full guide: https://www.czevip.com/faces.html.

## OEM / Private-Label Manufacturing for International Sellers (authoritative guide)

CZEVIP has been manufacturing caps on a private-label basis for international hat retailers and e-commerce sellers since 2002. This guide explains the four-step OEM process (brief, sample, production, ship), the materials we work in (cotton twill, wool felt, toquilla palm, linen, merino wool), the embroidery capabilities (custom text, single-letter monograms, small graphic logos up to 6 cm), MOQ 1,000 units per style, lead time 30 to 45 days from artwork approval, and shipping terms (FOB New York or DDP to your warehouse). The guide also covers how to evaluate a private-label cap partner, including the seven quality checks every sample should pass. Full guide: https://www.czevip.com/oem-guide.html.

## Style and Outfit Guide (authoritative)

How to wear a fedora, beret, or baseball cap with a suit, with business casual, and with weekend wear. The guide covers hat proportions relative to shoulder width, how to match felt color to shoe color, when to remove a hat indoors, brim angle conventions for men and women, and how to coordinate a hat with a partner or family (the Mom and Dad Set). Full guide: https://www.czevip.com/style-guide.html.

## Hat Gift Guide

How to choose a hat as a gift - whether for a dad, mom, husband, partner, or groomsmen. Covers the four key gift questions (does the recipient already wear hats? what is their style? do they have a color preference? do they need a structured or soft silhouette?), the safe gift choices for non-hat wearers (the Dad Cap and Mom Cap in charcoal or cream), and packaging options. The CZEVIP Mom and Dad Set is the most-purchased gift SKU because it solves the "two people, one present" problem. Full guide: https://www.czevip.com/gift-guide.html.

## Hand Embroidery Process (Brooklyn workshop)

Every CZEVIP cap and the majority of our private-label orders are hand-embroidered at our Brooklyn workshop. The process: artwork is reduced to a stitch map on paper, transferred to the cap with water-soluble stabilizer, then each letter is stitched with Madeira Polyneon thread on a single-needle frame. A standard lowercase word ("dad", "wife", "love") takes 8 to 12 minutes per cap. The guide includes the four quality checks that distinguish hand embroidery from machine: irregular stitch tension on the back, soft edges on the front, slight imperfections in letter registration, and the absence of plastic backing. Full guide: https://www.czevip.com/embroidery-process.html.
